name: ZIIVOS
title: Run the whole business from one dashboard
description: Our business management platform: point of sale, invoicing, payments, stock and purchasing in one place, with AI insights from DEDE, its built-in assistant.
summary: Invoices, payments, customers and insights for growing businesses, in one place.
overview: ZIIVOS is ZIIV’s own business management platform. It brings sales, money, marketing and insights together, so a business can see how it is doing at a glance and act on it.
DEDE, the built-in AI assistant, reads the numbers and recommends next steps, such as which customers to follow up with. ZIIVOS runs on desktop and mobile.

scope.name: Point of sale
scope.text: Quick sales, sales history and till summaries.

scope.name: Sales
scope.text: Customers, products, invoices, quotations and recurring billing.

scope.name: Money
scope.text: Payments, receipts and expenses, with outstanding and overdue amounts tracked.

scope.name: Marketing
scope.text: SMS and email to customers, from the same place.

scope.name: Insights
scope.text: Reports, activity and AI recommendations from DEDE.

scope.name: Operations
scope.text: Stock levels, team members and staff performance.

scope.name: Multi-tenant
scope.text: Many businesses on one platform, each with its own data.

standing: In use at ZIIV Technologies, on desktop and mobile.
